item.title: Morocco Turns Its Port Authority Into a Company — and Locks In $1.2B a Year for Regions
item.description: Ports of Morocco SA is born, regions get a 12-billion-dirham annual floor, Bank Al-Maghrib gets bank-resolution powers, and a new real-estate law shakes up how land gets developed — all from this week’s Official Gazette.

item.title: Morocco Borrows $460M From World Bank for Jobs and Green Growth While Its Own Watchdog Says Only 0.5% of Companies Ever Use Job-Training Funds
item.description: A digest of Morocco’s Official Gazette, issue №7526: a $460M World Bank loan for jobs and green growth, a damning report on Morocco’s broken job-training system, a new financial-futures player, and an offshore gas deal.
